_rule: Spoken text, not screen text. DiGi is always written Didgee here so the voice says it the way the app does (digi-squad/README.md). Imogen, Higgsfield text2speech_v2, variant elevenlabs, preset 3811e986-0891-47cf-a1f5-78a1d62a547a.
starts: Didgee starts with your child. It never says yes or no.
steps: It gives you two plain steps.
checkin-her: Then it goes on her check in, with one thing to try tonight.
checkin-his: Then it goes on his check in, with one thing to try tonight.
words: And here are the exact words to say.
later: A few days later, it asks how it went.
learns: Didgee learns your family. What worked before shapes what comes next.
end: What stage is your child? Three questions. No sign up.
